caption:
Narrated Abu 'Amir or Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari: that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "From among my followers there will be some people who will consider illegal sexual intercourse, the wearing of silk, the drinking of alcoholic drinks and the use of musical instruments, as lawful. And there will be some people who will stay near the side of a mountain and in the evening their shepherd will come to them with their sheep and ask them for something, but they will say to him, 'Return to us tomorrow.' Allah will destroy them during the night and will let the mountain fall on them, and He will transform the rest of them into monkeys and pigs and they will remain so till the Day of Resurrection."

Sahih al-Bukhari 5590. Part 52 of 52 in our series on everything the Quran and the Prophet's hadith say about zina. Swipe for the Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Hadith #Chastity #IslamicReminder #Deen #Guidance

sourcing.primary_text: Sahih al-Bukhari 5590 (hadith-api numbering; Book 74, Hadith 16). Selected from a full-text scan of all hadith-api English editions (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Malik, Nawawi, Dehlawi) for zina / adultery / fornication / illegal sexual intercourse / prostitution; one representative narration per distinct statement of the Prophet.
sourcing.arabic_and_english: Live-fetched twice on 2026-10-17 from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api@1/editions/ara-bukhari and eng-bukhari, HTTP 200, the two fetches diffed identical. Slides written programmatically from the API text.
sourcing.arabic_extraction: Arabic slide shows the Prophet's words only (text between the quotation marks, or a marked sub-range where the API Arabic has no quotes); chain of narrators omitted from the slide, not altered. Invisible directional marks and stray quote characters removed.
sourcing.english_note: English trimmed only at the edges where noted (chain/narrator commentary), punctuation restored at the end only. sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese_malay_thai_spani: hadith-api has no Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai or Spanish edition. These six slides are Claude's own translation from the verified Arabic and English, labelled on-slide as such; no scholar is named.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 halal-policy string terms across English and translations: hits = ["alcoholic"]. The text is the Prophet's teaching on the prohibition and legal treatment of zina; not promotional or explicit.
